title: IMAP mailboxes can be connected from a form
detail: The new write handler inbound-provider-imap:write:connect-mailbox (TenantAdmin, SystemAdmin, not exposed to the agent, 10 calls per tenant in 10 minutes) checks the IMAP login before the transaction, then creates a shared mail account and stores host, port, user and password in its credential secret in the same transaction. It always connects with implicit TLS (default port 993); there is no plaintext option, and a secure:false in the payload is ignored. A failed check stores nothing and answers with one of four texts: host not reachable or not allowed, login rejected, TLS failed, no connection. The form screen mail-account-connect-imap has a masked password field and no TLS toggle. New keys in all locale packages.

title: IMAP mailboxes send over their own SMTP server
detail: The connect form gets an optional field "Outgoing server (SMTP)". Left empty, the IMAP host is used, with smtp. in place of a leading imap.. connect-mailbox now also checks the SMTP login on port 465 (implicit TLS, same user and password, same host guard) and answers a failure with its own text ("Receiving works, but sending does not: ..."). The credential document gains smtpHost and smtpPort (default 465). The provider implements send: it sends over SMTP with From = the mailbox address and display name, then stores the same message in the sent folder (special use \Sent, else Sent, Gesendet or INBOX.Sent); a failed copy is only logged. Accounts stored without smtpHost answer mail_send_not_configured. New keys in all locale packages.

title: mailparser moved to a version without known nodemailer advisories
detail: mailparser moves to ^3.12.4, which pins nodemailer 10.2.1, so apps no longer get nodemailer 10.0.13 through it.

title: The deprecated inboundProviderImapFeature constant is removed
detail: inboundProviderImapFeature was kept next to createInboundProviderImapFeature() for one release. Mount the feature by calling createInboundProviderImapFeature().
migration: Run bun kumiko-upgrade --apply. It replaces inboundProviderImapFeature with createInboundProviderImapFeature().

title: inbound-provider-imap declares the MAIL_ALLOWED_PRIVATE_HOSTS env schema
migration: No action needed. An app that mounts both mail-transport-smtp and inbound-provider-imap now composes one shared field.

title: The tenant-configured IMAP host must resolve to a public address
migration:
An operator relying on an internal IMAP server or a local dev/test server
(greenmail on localhost or a private IP) now gets an InboundAuthError
(account marked auth_error) unless that host is explicitly allowed. Set
the same operator env var mail-transport-smtp reads (comma-separated, no
boot-time code call needed) before starting the process:
  KUMIKO_MAIL_ALLOWED_PRIVATE_HOSTS=greenmail.internal
This is an operator env var, not a tenant config value — a tenant cannot
add their own host to this list. A DNS resolution failure for a
genuinely unreachable host now surfaces as InboundTransientError (job
retry) instead of reaching imapflow at all.

title: IMAP connect failures no longer distinguish a blocked host from a DNS failure in the thrown message
detail:
`createImapClient` throws the same generic message
("IMAP host is not reachable or not allowed") for both a blocked host
(`InboundAuthError`) and a DNS resolution failure (`InboundTransientError`).
The configured host and the underlying error are now logged via the
feature's own logger instead of being embedded in the thrown message.
Error class (and therefore retry behavior) is unchanged.
